slices.title: BFF routes, action contract, ZDR interplay
slices.summary: Adds BFF routes GET and PUT /api/v1/orgs/{id}/model-entitlement and GET .../explain (admin gate on writes), a ZDR write guard that refuses a policy leaving no attested model (409, fail-closed 503), the zdr switch gate reading hidden_count, and the org.set_model_entitlement action (approval required, not model-executable), all behind MODEL_ENTITLEMENT_ADMIN_ENABLED (default false).
